digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center comment sanitization and truncation
propositions: rebar hardcodes DC comment ceiling to 32767 (WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT) but jira.text.field.character.limit is admin-settable from 0 (unlimited) to 2147483647, causing silent data loss when an instance raises or removes the limit

sanitize_comment and fit_comment both depend on fit_outbound (the description fitter), but comments and descriptions have separate semantics and Cloud's ADF-size-based description fitting would be catastrophically wrong if applied to comments

the DC comment ceiling must be configurable via [tool.rebar.reconciler].comment_max_chars defaulting to 32767 with coercer range 0 to 2147483647, and auto-derived env override REBAR_RECONCILER_COMMENT_MAX_CHARS
sanitize_comment must be decoupled from the description fitter so future changes to description fitting cannot silently retarget comment truncation
WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT is misattributed in comments to Cloud when it actually derives from jira.text.field.character.limit default and JRASERVER-28519
